archetypes.name: markdown-parser-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Fence syntax and source-offset preservation can create subtle section-boundary regressions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan against the current digest parser and tests. Check that the proposed fence rules handle marker character, marker length, info strings, unclosed fences, and absolute section offsets without changing existing h2/h3 output. Flag any missing test that could allow a phantom heading or truncated canonical section. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
